def my_find(s1, s2, start):
    for i in range(start, len(s1)):
        if s1[i] == s2[0]:
            f = True
            for j in range(i + 1, i + len(s2)):
                if j >= len(s1) or s2[j - i] != s1[j]:
                    f = False
                    break
            if f:
                return i
    return -1

def main():
    s1 = input()
    pos = my_find(s1, "at", 1)
    s2 = s1[:pos] + '@' + s1[pos+2:]
    ans = ""
    i = my_find(s2, "dot", 1)
    last = 0
    while i != -1 and i < len(s2) - 3:
        ans += s2[last:i] + "."
        last = i + 3
        i = my_find(s2, "dot", last)
    ans += s2[last:]
    print(ans)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
